squat.name: Squat
squat.cue: Feet shoulder-width apart, knees tracking over your toes, back straight; lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.

sumo_squat.name: Sumo squat
sumo_squat.cue: Feet wider than shoulders, toes turned out; lower straight down and push your knees out to the sides.

sit_to_stand.name: Chair sit-to-stand
sit_to_stand.cue: Sit on the edge of a stable chair and stand up without using your hands; sit back down slowly.

wall_sit.name: Wall sit
wall_sit.cue: Back pressed against the wall, knees over your feet at about 90°; breathe steadily.

forward_lunge.name: Forward lunge
forward_lunge.cue: Step forward and bend both knees to about 90°, keeping the front knee from caving inward; push back off the front foot to return.

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.cue: Step back and lower the back knee toward the floor; keep your weight on the front leg. A knee-friendly option.

split_squat.name: Split squat
split_squat.cue: Stand in a long stride and squat in place without moving your feet; keep your torso upright.

side_lunge.name: Side lunge
side_lunge.cue: Take a wide step to the side and sit into the working leg while the other leg stays straight; push your hips back.

curtsy_lunge.name: Curtsy lunge
curtsy_lunge.cue: Step one leg back diagonally behind the standing leg, as in a curtsy; keep the standing knee over your foot.

walking_lunge.name: Walking lunge
walking_lunge.cue: Forward lunges, alternating legs as you move forward; you need a clear path.

step_up.name: Step-up
step_up.cue: Step up onto a stable step or low bench with your whole foot, pushing through the top leg.

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian_split_squat.cue: Rear foot on a sofa or chair, squat on the front leg; hold on to a wall if needed.

pistol_assisted.name: Assisted pistol squat
pistol_assisted.cue: Squat on one leg with the other leg extended forward, holding a door frame with one hand.

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.cue: Lying on your back with your feet close to your hips; raise your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line, squeezing your glutes.

single_leg_bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single_leg_bridge.cue: Like the regular bridge, but with one leg extended; do not let your hips tilt to one side.

hip_thrust_sofa.name: Sofa hip thrust
hip_thrust_sofa.cue: Shoulder blades on the edge of the sofa, feet on the floor; raise your hips until your torso is level with the floor, chin toward your chest.

donkey_kick.name: Donkey kick
donkey_kick.cue: On all fours, lift your bent leg with the heel toward the ceiling; do not let your lower back arch.

fire_hydrant.name: Fire hydrant
fire_hydrant.cue: On all fours, lift your bent leg out to the side; keep your torso still.

side_leg_raise.name: Side-lying leg raise
side_leg_raise.cue: Lying on your side, raise the straight top leg with your toes pointing forward, without rolling your hips back.

calf_raise.name: Calf raise
calf_raise.cue: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly; you can hold on to a wall.

single_calf_raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single_calf_raise.cue: The same on one leg, from the edge of a step if possible for a full range of motion.

good_morning.name: Bodyweight good morning
good_morning.cue: Hands behind your head, knees slightly bent; bend forward with a straight back by pushing your hips back.

single_leg_rdl.name: Bodyweight single-leg deadlift
single_leg_rdl.cue: Standing on one leg, lean forward with a straight back while the other leg goes back; balance matters more than depth.

jump_squat.name: Jump squat
jump_squat.cue: Squat down, then jump powerfully upward; land softly on your toes and move straight into the next squat.

jump_lunge.name: Jumping lunge
jump_lunge.cue: From a lunge, switch legs with a jump; land softly and keep your knees from caving inward.

wall_pushup.name: Wall push-up
wall_pushup.cue: Palms on the wall at chest height, body straight; bend your arms until your chest touches the wall.

incline_pushup.name: Incline push-up
incline_pushup.cue: Hands on a stable surface (table or sofa), body in a straight line; the lower the surface, the harder it is.

knee_pushup.name: Push-up on knees
knee_pushup.cue: Support yourself on your knees and palms, with a straight line from knees to shoulders; lower your chest toward the floor.

pushup.name: Push-up
pushup.cue: Palms slightly wider than shoulders, body straight, elbows at about 45° to your torso.

wide_pushup.name: Wide push-up
wide_pushup.cue: Hands wider than usual, emphasizing the chest; do not let your hips sag.

diamond_pushup.name: Diamond push-up
diamond_pushup.cue: Palms together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond; elbows close to your body.

decline_pushup.name: Decline push-up
decline_pushup.cue: Feet on the sofa, hands on the floor; keep your torso straight and do not arch your lower back.

pike_pushup.name: Pike push-up
pike_pushup.cue: Hips high, body in an inverted V; lower the top of your head toward the floor between your palms.

hindu_pushup.name: Hindu push-up
hindu_pushup.cue: From the pike position, dive your chest forward along the floor into an upward arch, then return back.

chair_dip.name: Chair dip
chair_dip.cue: Palms on the edge of a stable chair behind you; bend your elbows back to 90° and do not raise your shoulders toward your ears.

plank_updown.name: Plank up-down
plank_updown.cue: From a forearm plank, move one hand at a time up into a high plank and back down; do not let your hips rock.

plank_shoulder_tap.name: Plank shoulder tap
plank_shoulder_tap.cue: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder; keep your feet wider so your hips do not sway.

wall_slide.name: Wall slide
wall_slide.cue: Back and forearms pressed against the wall; slide your arms up and down without lifting them off the wall.

incline_pike_pushup.name: Incline pike push-up
incline_pike_pushup.cue: Palms on the edge of the sofa, hips high; lower your head toward the edge by bending your elbows.

bear_crawl.name: Bear crawl
bear_crawl.cue: On all fours with your knees a few centimeters off the floor, move forward and backward in short steps.

superman.name: Superman
superman.cue: Lying face down, raise your arms and legs a few centimeters at the same time, eyes on the floor.

ytw_raise.name: Prone Y-T-W raise
ytw_raise.cue: Lying face down, raise your arms into the letters Y, T and W, squeezing your shoulder blades together; keep your neck neutral.

snow_angel.name: Reverse snow angel
snow_angel.cue: Lying face down, sweep your arms, held just above the floor, in an arc from your hips to your head and back.

swimmer.name: Prone swimmer
swimmer.cue: Lying face down, alternately raise the opposite arm and leg at a fast pace.

cobra_hold.name: Prone cobra hold
cobra_hold.cue: Lying face down, lift your chest, squeeze your shoulder blades together and turn your palms outward; hold.

doorframe_row.name: Doorframe row
doorframe_row.cue: Grip a sturdy door frame, lean back and pull your chest toward the frame. Use only a secure support.

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.cue: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg into one line; keep your hips still.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.cue: Lying on your back with your knees bent; lift your shoulder blades off the floor without pulling your head with your hands.

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse_crunch.cue: Lying on your back, pull your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips slightly off the floor.

heel_touch.name: Heel touch
heel_touch.cue: With your shoulder blades lifted, reach alternately toward the heel on the same side.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.cue: Lying on your back with your lower back pressed down; lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.

plank.name: Forearm plank
plank.cue: Elbows under your shoulders, body straight from heels to head, glutes and abs tight.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.cue: Support yourself on one elbow and your feet, hips lifted, body in one line; an easier version is from the knees.

hollow_hold.name: Hollow body hold
hollow_hold.cue: Lying on your back with your lower back pressed down, lift your shoulders and straight legs off the floor.

leg_raise.name: Lying leg raise
leg_raise.cue: Lying on your back, raise your straight legs to vertical; keep your lower back pressed down and lower slowly.

flutter_kick.name: Flutter kick
flutter_kick.cue: Lying on your back, keep your legs low above the floor and make quick up-and-down kicks, lower back pressed down.

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle_crunch.cue: Alternately bring an elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg straightens.

situp.name: Sit-up
situp.cue: From lying down, come up to sitting with your feet on the floor; do not jerk.

russian_twist.name: Russian twist
russian_twist.cue: Sitting and leaning back, rotate your torso from side to side, keeping your back straight.

v_up.name: V-up
v_up.cue: Lying on your back, raise your straight arms and legs at the same time and touch your feet.

side_plank_dip.name: Side plank hip dip
side_plank_dip.cue: In a side plank, lower your hips toward the floor and raise them above the line of your body.

jumping_jacks.name: Jumping jacks
jumping_jacks.cue: Jump your feet out to the sides with your arms overhead, then back; land on your toes.

step_jacks.name: Step jacks
step_jacks.cue: Like jumping jacks, but step out to each side in turn instead of jumping; quiet and easy on the joints.

jog_in_place.name: Jogging in place
jog_in_place.cue: Light jog in place on your toes, arms moving as when running.

butt_kicks.name: Butt kicks
butt_kicks.cue: Jog in place, with your heels touching your glutes.

high_knees.name: High knees
high_knees.cue: Fast running in place, knees up to hip level, torso upright.

skip_imitation.name: Air jump rope
skip_imitation.cue: Low jumps on your toes with your wrists turning, as if using a jump rope.

lateral_shuffle.name: Lateral shuffle
lateral_shuffle.cue: In a half squat, quickly move from side to side with shuffle steps.

skater_jump.name: Skater jump
skater_jump.cue: Jump from foot to foot sideways like a speed skater; land softly.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain climber
mountain_climber.cue: In a high plank, quickly drive your knees toward your chest in turn; do not raise your hips.

plank_jack.name: Plank jack
plank_jack.cue: In a high plank, jump your feet apart and together; keep your torso still.

half_burpee.name: Half burpee
half_burpee.cue: Squat down, step or jump back into a plank, return, and stand up with no jump and no push-up.

squat_thrust.name: Squat thrust
squat_thrust.cue: From a crouch with your hands on the floor, jump back into a plank and return, then stand up.

inchworm.name: Inchworm
inchworm.cue: Bend forward, walk your hands out to a plank and back to your feet.

burpee.name: Burpee
burpee.cue: Squat down, drop into a plank, do a push-up, return, and jump up with a clap overhead.

star_jump.name: Star jump
star_jump.cue: From a squat, jump powerfully, spreading your arms and legs out to the sides.

tuck_jump.name: Tuck jump
tuck_jump.cue: Jump up, pulling your knees toward your chest; land softly.

stairs.name: Stair climbing
stairs.cue: Climb the stairs of your building at a steady pace and come down calmly; hold the handrail.

stairs_fast.name: Fast stair climbing
stairs_fast.cue: Climb the steps quickly, one at a time, and walk down to recover.

step_aerobics.name: Step aerobics
step_aerobics.cue: Rhythmic steps up onto a low step (about 10 cm) and back down, switching the leading leg.

dance_low.name: Low-impact aerobics or dance
dance_low.cue: Rhythmic movement to music without jumping.

dance_high.name: High-impact aerobics or dance
dance_high.cue: Energetic movement to music with jumps and quick changes of steps.

zumba_video.name: Zumba video workout
zumba_video.cue: A workout following a Zumba video lesson at home.

video_cardio.name: Cardio video workout, moderate
video_cardio.cue: A video workout combining cardio and strength exercises at a moderate pace.

video_cardio_hard.name: Cardio video workout, vigorous
video_cardio_hard.cue: An intense video workout; your breathing speeds up noticeably.

circuit_bw.name: Bodyweight circuit
circuit_bw.cue: Alternate 5–8 exercises of 30–40 s each with almost no rest, for 2–4 rounds.

hiit_moderate.name: Interval training (HIIT), moderate
hiit_moderate.cue: Intervals of 20–40 s of work with equal rest; the pace is high but under control.

tabata.name: Tabata (high-intensity HIIT)
tabata.cue: 20 s of all-out work (burpees, mountain climbers, jumps) and 10 s of rest, 8 rounds per block.

walk_moderate.name: Moderate-pace walking
walk_moderate.cue: Walking at about 4.5–5.5 km/h on a flat surface.

walk_brisk.name: Brisk walking
walk_brisk.cue: Walking at about 5.6–6.3 km/h; you can talk, but it takes effort.

arm_circles.name: Arm circles
arm_circles.cue: Rotate your straight arms forward and backward, gradually increasing the range.

hip_circles.name: Hip circles
hip_circles.cue: Hands on your waist, make smooth circles with your hips in both directions.

cat_cow.name: Cat-cow
cat_cow.cue: On all fours, smoothly alternate between arching and rounding your back in time with your breathing.

worlds_greatest.name: World's greatest stretch
worlds_greatest.cue: In a deep lunge, place one hand on the floor and rotate your torso, reaching the other arm toward the ceiling.

hamstring_stretch.name: Hamstring stretch
hamstring_stretch.cue: Sitting or standing, reach toward your foot with a straight back until you feel a light stretch; no bouncing.

quad_stretch.name: Quad stretch
quad_stretch.cue: Standing next to a wall, pull your heel toward your glute, knees together, pelvis tucked under.

chest_stretch.name: Doorway chest stretch
chest_stretch.cue: Forearm on the door frame at shoulder height; step forward until you feel a light stretch in your chest.

childs_pose.name: Child's pose
childs_pose.cue: Sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward along the floor; relax your back and breathe deeply.

stretch_session.name: Full stretching session
stretch_session.cue: Gentle stretching of the main muscles, 20–30 s for each position.

pilates.name: Mat Pilates
pilates.cue: Controlled exercises for the core muscles and posture, following a program or video.

yoga_hatha.name: Hatha yoga
yoga_hatha.cue: Calm practice of poses with holds and attention to your breathing.

sun_salutation.name: Sun salutation (Surya Namaskar)
sun_salutation.cue: A sequence of 12 positions, repeated continuously at your own pace.

yoga_vinyasa.name: Vinyasa yoga
yoga_vinyasa.cue: Smooth transitions between poses, synchronized with your breathing.

db_goblet_squat.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
db_goblet_squat.cue: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest and squat so that your elbows pass between your knees.

db_squat.name: Dumbbell squat
db_squat.cue: Dumbbells in your hanging hands or on your shoulders; technique as in a regular squat.

db_sumo_squat.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
db_sumo_squat.cue: Wide stance, dumbbell hanging between your legs; squat with a straight back.

db_rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
db_rdl.cue: Dumbbells slide along your legs, knees slightly bent, back straight; bend forward by pushing your hips back.

db_deadlift.name: Dumbbell deadlift
db_deadlift.cue: Squat down to the dumbbells with a straight back and stand up, extending your legs and hips at the same time.

db_lunge.name: Dumbbell lunge
db_lunge.cue: Dumbbells in your hanging hands; lunge forward or in place, torso upright.

db_reverse_lunge.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
db_reverse_lunge.cue: Step back holding dumbbells, with the back knee going toward the floor.

db_step_up.name: Dumbbell step-up
db_step_up.cue: Step up onto a stable step with dumbbells in your hanging hands.

db_bulgarian.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
db_bulgarian.cue: Rear foot on a sofa, dumbbells in your hands; squat on the front leg.

db_glute_bridge.name: Dumbbell glute bridge
db_glute_bridge.cue: Dumbbell resting on your hips, steady it with your hands; raise your hips, squeezing your glutes.

db_calf_raise.name: Dumbbell calf raise
db_calf_raise.cue: Dumbbells in your hands, rise onto your toes with a pause at the top.

db_swing.name: Dumbbell swing
db_swing.cue: Hold the dumbbell with both hands and swing it up to chest level with a powerful hip extension. The estimate is based on kettlebell swings.

db_floor_press.name: Dumbbell floor press
db_floor_press.cue: Lying on the floor, press the dumbbells up; your elbows touch the floor at the bottom.

db_floor_fly.name: Dumbbell floor fly
db_floor_fly.cue: Arms slightly bent, open the dumbbells in an arc until your elbows touch the floor.

db_shoulder_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
db_shoulder_press.cue: Seated or standing, press the dumbbells up from shoulder level; do not arch your lower back.

db_arnold_press.name: Arnold press
db_arnold_press.cue: Start with your palms facing you at shoulder level and rotate them forward as you press up.

db_lateral_raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
db_lateral_raise.cue: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder level, elbows slightly bent, light weight.

db_front_raise.name: Dumbbell front raise
db_front_raise.cue: Raise the dumbbells forward to shoulder level, alternating or together.

db_rear_fly.name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
db_rear_fly.cue: Bent over with a straight back, raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

db_bent_row.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
db_bent_row.cue: Bend forward with a straight back and pull the dumbbells to your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

db_one_arm_row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
db_one_arm_row.cue: One hand and knee on the sofa, pull the dumbbell to your waist with the other hand.

db_renegade_row.name: Renegade row
db_renegade_row.cue: In a plank position on the dumbbells, pull them to your waist one at a time, keeping your hips level.

db_pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
db_pullover.cue: Lying on the floor, lower the dumbbell behind your head with straight arms and bring it back over your chest.

db_shrug.name: Dumbbell shrug
db_shrug.cue: Raise your shoulders toward your ears without rolling them and lower them slowly.

db_biceps_curl.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
db_biceps_curl.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, curl the dumbbells without swinging.

db_hammer_curl.name: Hammer curl
db_hammer_curl.cue: Palms facing each other, curl the dumbbells with your elbows still.

db_overhead_triceps.name: Overhead triceps extension
db_overhead_triceps.cue: Hold one dumbbell with both hands behind your head and extend your elbows upward, with your elbows pointing forward.

db_kickback.name: Triceps kickback
db_kickback.cue: Bent over with your upper arm pinned to your side, extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.

db_skull_crusher.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
db_skull_crusher.cue: Lying down, lower the dumbbells toward your temples by bending your elbows and extend them back up.

db_side_bend.name: Dumbbell side bend
db_side_bend.cue: Dumbbell in one hand, bend to the side and return using your oblique muscles.

db_russian_twist.name: Dumbbell Russian twist
db_russian_twist.cue: Sitting and leaning back, pass the dumbbell from side to side by turning your torso.

db_woodchop.name: Dumbbell woodchop
db_woodchop.cue: Diagonal movement of the dumbbell from your hip to the opposite shoulder, rotating your torso.

db_farmer_hold.name: Farmer's hold
db_farmer_hold.cue: Stand or walk with heavy dumbbells in your hanging hands, shoulders down, torso upright.

db_thruster.name: Dumbbell thruster
db_thruster.cue: Squat with the dumbbells at your shoulders and, as you rise, press them overhead in one movement.

db_clean_press.name: Dumbbell clean and press
db_clean_press.cue: From a hanging position, pop the dumbbells up to your shoulders by extending your hips, then press them overhead.

db_strength_session.name: Dumbbell strength workout
db_strength_session.cue: Several exercises of 8–15 reps with rest between sets.

db_circuit.name: Dumbbell circuit
db_circuit.cue: Alternate upper-body and lower-body exercises with almost no rest, 3–4 rounds.
